To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the target compounds are cytotoxic against L‐121O and HL‐60 cells.
a series of 4, 5‐dihyro‐5‐[aryloxy]‐methylfuran‐2(5H)‐ones were synthesized and tested as potential antitumor agents.
the enantiomeric 4,5-dihydrofuranones 8 were synthesized by asymmetric Sharpless dihydroylation of the 5-aryl-pent-4-enoic acids 14, followed by Horne-Wadsworth-Emmons reaction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of enantiomer‐pure 5‐hydroxymethylated furanones 8 by means of Sharpless dihydroxylations of 5‐aryl pent‐4‐enoates 13.
the synthesis of 4, 5‐dihydropyrans and 4, 4‐disubstituted cyclopentenones.
the development of a novel class of cytotoxic furanones.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 5‐hydroxy group is important for cytotoxicity, and that the 4‐hydroxy group has a minor effect.
the cytotoxicity of 4, 5‐dihyro‐5‐[arylmethyl]‐3,4‐dimethylidenefuranones is not related to the configuration of the chiral carbon center.
the enantiomeric purity of the 5‐aryl(hydroxy)‐methyl‐furanones has a significant impact on the cytotoxic activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we could develop a novel class of cytotoxins, which are based on a furanone scaffold.
the 5‐aryl(hydroxy)‐methylfuranone derivatives 8 show cytotoxic activity against leukemia cell lines and that the activity is influenced by the absolute configuration of the compounds.
the 4,5-dihydro-5-(aryl(hydroxy) methyl)-3-methylidenefuran-2(3H)-ones are a promising class of new cytotoxic compounds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the enantiomeric purity of the target compounds 4,5-dihydro-5-(aryl(hydroxy)-methyl)-3-methylidene-furan-2(3H)-one is important for their biological activity.
the enantiomer of a given chiral compound is not always identical to its enantiomer.
the Sharpless dihydroxylations can be used as a tool for the preparation of enantiopure compounds.
